A: Fist with thumb resting upright against the side of the index finger.
B: Flat hand with four fingers straight up, thumb tucked across palm.
C: Curved hand forming a 'C' shape with thumb and fingers.
D: Index finger pointing up, remaining fingers curled touching thumb to form a circle.
E: Fingers curled down with fingertips resting against the tucked thumb.
F: Index finger and thumb touching to form a circle, other three fingers upright.
G: Index finger and thumb parallel and pointing horizontally to the side.
H: Index and middle fingers extended horizontally together.
I: Pinky finger extended straight up, all other fingers curled into a fist.
J: Extend pinky and trace a downward 'J' hook shape in the air (Motion Gesture).
K: Index finger pointing up, middle finger angled forward, thumb resting on middle knuckle.
L: Index finger pointing up and thumb pointing out to form an 'L' shape.
M: Fist with thumb tucked under the first three fingers (index, middle, ring).
N: Fist with thumb tucked under the first two fingers (index and middle).
O: All fingertips touching the thumb to form an 'O' circle.
P: Same shape as 'K', but pointing downward toward the ground.
Q: Same shape as 'G', but pointing downward toward the ground.
R: Index and middle fingers crossed tightly together, pointing up.
S: Fist with thumb crossed horizontally over the front of the fingers.
T: Fist with thumb tucked between the index and middle fingers.
U: Index and middle fingers extended straight up together.
V: Index and middle fingers extended in a 'V' peace sign.
W: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended upward in a 'W' shape.
X: Index finger bent like a hook, remaining fingers folded.
Y: Thumb and pinky extended out, middle three fingers folded (hang ten).
Z: Index finger tracing a 'Z' shape in the air (Motion Gesture).
